notes: Fractional complexity-based credits (a message can cost 0.5 or 2.0 credits) with sliding-scale plan pricing per workspace, not per seat. Failed/unwanted generations consume credits, no refunds.

change_events.description: Shift from flat message counts to fractional complexity-based credits with daily credits and rollover (iterative rollout through 2025; exact date approximated to mid-2025 — reported only, docs changelog). Original late-2024 launch was $20/mo near-unlimited messaging, then message counts, then credits.
change_events.user_reaction: Modest recurring complaints about credit burn on errors; no single backlash event

sources.note: Reported repricing history; verify against docs.lovable.dev/changelog

plans.name: Free
plans.whats_gated: 5 daily credits (max 30/mo), unlimited workspace members, private projects

limits.unlimited_definition: unlimited members — metering is per workspace credits

plans.name: Pro (sliding scale)
plans.billing_unit: per 100 credits/month, scaling to 10,000 credits at $2,250/mo (~16% annual discount)
plans.whats_gated: Custom domains, badge removal, Code mode, roles/permissions, daily credits up to 150/mo

limits.throttle_behavior: hard stop; top-ups $15/50 credits (max 1,000, valid 12 months)

plans.name: Business (sliding scale)
plans.billing_unit: per 100 credits/month (2x Pro per-credit price), to 10,000 at $4,300/mo
plans.whats_gated: SSO, restricted projects, data-training opt-out, per-user credit limits

usage_meters.rate: simple edit ~0.5 credits; landing page ~1.7–2.0 credits
usage_meters.overage_behavior: hard stop until top-up (Pro $15/50, Business $30/50) or upgrade

credits_system.credit_definition: Fractional credits deducted per message by task complexity
credits_system.credit_to_compute_mapping: Partially transparent: examples published, exact formula not
credits_system.expiry: Monthly credits roll over 1 month (monthly plans) or remainder of term (annual); daily credits never roll; all expire on cancellation; top-ups valid 12 months

predictability.refund_on_failure_policy: none — failed/unwanted generations consume credits; refunds not offered (documented in docs)
